featured_projects.name: LetsGo South Africa - AI-Powered Tourism Platform
featured_projects.summary: Built a full-stack tourism web application for LetsGo South Africa, enabling admins to create, manage, and publish travel packages while customers browse packages, submit online enquiries, and chat with an AI agent for travel-related questions.
featured_projects.problem_solved: Provides a modern digital platform for managing tourism packages, improving package discovery, and supporting customer enquiries through both forms and AI-assisted chat.
key_features: Admin package creation, editing, publishing, and image management
AI travel assistant for package and travel-related questions

featured_projects.name: BeautyVerse - Beauty Services Marketplace
featured_projects.description: Built a beauty services marketplace where providers can create and manage service listings while customers can browse services and submit enquiries.
highlights: Designed a reusable marketplace foundation with listings, categories, users, images, and enquiries.
Implemented FastAPI backend services with PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, and Docker-based local development.
Built listing workflows for provider-owned service creation, public browsing, and customer enquiry submission.
Worked with authentication and role-based access patterns for provider/customer style marketplace flows.
Structured the project so the marketplace foundation could be adapted to other domains such as room rentals.

featured_projects.name: MedDesk - AI Clinical Intake Proof of Concept
featured_projects.summary: Built a proof-of-concept clinical intake system where patients can chat with an AI assistant to report symptoms before seeing a practitioner. The system collects Subjective and patient-reported Objective information, stores the conversation, detects red-flag symptoms, and prepares structured draft SOAP notes for clinician review.
featured_projects.problem_solved: Helps structure patient intake before the consultation, reducing unstructured handover information and giving clinicians a reviewable draft rather than an automated diagnosis.
key_features: Subjective and patient-reported Objective information collection
technical_highlights: Backend APIs for intake sessions and messages
Designed as clinician-support software rather than diagnostic automation
featured_projects.important_boundary: The system is positioned as a proof of concept for intake support and clinician review, not as a replacement for professional medical judgment.

featured_projects.name: Personal Website Digital Twin / Portfolio AI Assistant
featured_projects.summary: Built an AI assistant for a personal portfolio website that answers questions about my background, projects, technical experience, and professional interests using a structured profile and grounded context.
featured_projects.problem_solved: Allows visitors to interactively explore my experience and projects instead of only reading a static CV.
technical_highlights: Profile JSON and summary files as knowledge sources
